subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing preference and sample invoice template
messages:
From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acmeanalytics.com>

Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing preference and sample invoice template

Hi Priyom / Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. We're getting close to onboarding Redwood as a supplier for the next quarter and need to confirm the preferred invoice submission approach and a sample layout so our AP team can align. A few quick questions: 

- Is the vendor portal mandatory for go-live, or can we use email as a temporary fallback while we complete the portal setup?
- If email fallback is allowed, what email subject format or token does Redwood expect so invoices auto-route?
- Do you require PO stamping (PO number printed on the invoice header) or a separate PO mapping file?
- Do you have a preferred file format for multi-PO invoices (single PDF with multiple PO lines, CSV with PO column, or separate invoice per PO)?
- Any required fields we should ensure are in the invoice (tax id, remit-to address, GL code)?

I've attached a sample invoice layout we currently issue (PDF) so you can see our columns. We can adapt quickly but want to avoid rework if Redwood has a strict minimal schema.

Appreciate any constraints or a quick checklist. If you'd prefer, we can schedule a 20-min call tomorrow to walk the AP team through the changes.

Best,
Laura Simmons
Procurement Lead, Acme Analytics
laura.simmons@acmeanalytics.com
Attachments: sample-invoice-acme.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing preference and sample invoice template

Laura — thanks for the clear ask and for attaching the sample. High level answers up front, then a couple of asks so we can keep the onboarding window tight: 

1) Portal vs email: Portal is our preferred long-term path (better tracking, acknowledgements, PO matching). That said, we do allow email as a temporary fallback during onboarding. If you use email fallback, please use our subject token format exactly: "RDW-INVOICE: <vendor_id> <po_number>" (example: RDW-INVOICE: ACME12345 PO-98765). The token triggers our ingest pipeline and reduces manual routing.

2) PO stamping: We require the PO number (PO-xxxxx) on the invoice header (visible) for automated PO-match. Separately, if you have multi-PO invoices, include a CSV line-level mapping with columns: invoice_id, po_number, item_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total. This is the cleanest for our AP system.

3) File formats: Preferred is a single PDF invoice plus an accompanying CSV for line-level PO mappings when multiple POs are present on one invoice. If you cannot produce CSV, a single-line-per-PO PDF structure is acceptable.

4) Required fields: vendor_tax_id (VAT/GST if applicable), remit_to name and address, invoice_date, invoice_number, PO number(s), and a subtotal + tax + total breakdown. GL codes are optional but helpful.

Operational notes: our acknowledgement SLA is 24 business hours for portal submissions and 48 hours for email fallback. Please include the vendor onboarding form so we can provision a vendor_id (ACME12345) and whitelist your email domain for fallback ingest. I've attached the onboarding form — fill the bank details section if you want ACH enabled at go-live.

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Next step ask: can you fill the attached vendor form and re-send the sample invoice with the PO token in the subject for a short ingestion test? If yes, Jordan will coordinate the test window and go-live target.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing preference and sample invoice template

Priyom — thank you, that guidance is helpful. Quick replies inline: 

- Portal: we'll prioritize portal but can start with email fallback for the first invoice run. We'll use the subject token you provided.
- PO stamping: we can ensure the PO is on the invoice header. For large invoices that span multiple POs we'll generate the CSV mapping as requested.
- File formats: we'll send a PDF + CSV for the multi-PO pilot.
- Required fields: our invoice generator includes tax id and remit address; we'll add GL codes as an optional column.

I've completed the vendor onboarding form and attached it, and re-sent the sample invoice in the requested subject format for your ingest test. We are also including our ACH details on the onboarding form.

If the ingest test looks good, we'd like to target a pilot go-live for 2028-08-22 with a low-volume invoice run. Does that work?

Thanks,
Laura Simmons
Procurement Lead, Acme Analytics
laura.simmons@acmeanalytics.com
